close_reason: Stale: find_immutable_patch_key uses const &[&str] linear scan (no OnceLock<HashSet>). Existing doc at helpers.rs:83 explains the design.
description: find_immutable_patch_key (email.rs:1253) builds a HashSet from IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS using OnceLock, so the set is only allocated and populated once per process. The exact-match path is then O(1) per key in the patch. A contributor might suggest switching to a static sorted array + binary search (no allocation), which would be marginally more cache-friendly for 18 entries, but the OnceLock<HashSet> approach is correct and avoids a sorted-array maintenance requirement. The redundant linear scan for the return value (JMAP-yqo.16) is a separate fixable issue.
title: Email/set immutable-field guard uses OnceLock<HashSet> for O(1) amortized lookup
